Open a Xunlai Storage account to store your possessions.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = nightfall
}}
* Not upholding [[Melandru's Accord]]

===Objectives===
* Talk to a [[Xunlai Agent]] and open a storage account.
* See [[Xunlai Agent Jueh]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]

==Walkthrough==
With the money you earned from completing quests in [[Chahbek Village]] (plus completing the first mission), you should have more than enough money to give your new character access to your storage ''and'' add access to the crafting material storage.  It will cost 100 [[gold]] to accomplish this feat.  Simply walk up the stairs to the north and turn right and speak with the other Xunlai Agents.

'''Note:''' You only need to open the account in order to complete the quest, but it's easier to kill two birds with one stone by adding the crafting material storage.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Xunlai Agent Jueh
:''"Greetings, «profession»!  My name is Jueh and I work for the Xunlai.  We can hold onto items or gold that you would like to keep but don't want to carry around with you.  Talk to one of our Xunlai professionals to open an account with us for a minimal fee.  There are no other fees for using our services; we just require a small amount of gold to open the account.  Thereafter you will be able to leave items in your vault and access them wherever one of our agents is located.  You will even be able to access the items in your storage with other characters on your account.  You can place an item into storage with one character and take it out with another character, as long as they both can find a Xunlai agent."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Sounds good.  This backpack was getting heavy.
| decline = A bit too expensive.  Perhaps later?
| ask = Have you opened your storage vault with the Xunlai yet?
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Xunlai Agent Jueh
:''"Wondeful!  You have activated your storage account!  I think you'll find that having an account with the Xunlai is very beneficial.  As a special bonus for opening an account with us, we have a small gift for you.  Thank you for using our services.  We will protect your items with our lives!"''
